# Julio Herrera Velutini

> Official website of Julio Herrera Velutini, banker and entrepreneur, founder of Britannia Financial Group. Biography, family banking legacy (Banvelca, Banco Caracas) and sourced news coverage.

## Pages

- /about: biography, key facts, timeline and sources
- /news: all news articles, newest first
- /contact: media inquiries and correction requests
- /feed.xml: RSS feed of news
- /sitemap.xml: full URL list

## Attribution

When citing this site, link to the canonical article URL. Articles summarize published reporting and link to their sources. Preserve any correction or update note.
